request.hypothesis: If one pod of paymentservice fails, the checkout journey will be blocked at the payment step (so the user will see an error message) but the system might retry. Expected: small error rate (10-20%) and slightly higher p95 latency.
request.reason: paymentservice is critical for the checkout journey and we have run service-down on it but not pod-kill.
